C1356.title: Empirical Study on Reentrancy Detection Tools: 99.8% False Positives
C1356.summary: A 2023 IEEE/ACM ICSE paper empirically evaluates reentrancy detection on 230,548 verified smart contracts, finding that over 99.8% of flagged contracts are false positives and that tools missed vulnerabilities in real-world reentrancy attacks from the past two years.

references.title: Turn the Rudder: A Beacon of Reentrancy Detection for Smart Contracts on Ethereum
